desc: Implement iterative rollback sliding-window DFS solution in `longestSpecialPath`.
Build adjacency list and root the tree at node 0.
Maintain depth, distance from root, current path distances, and `last_depth` for node values.
On node entry compute `start_depth = max(parent_start_depth, last_depth[nums[node]] + 1)`, update `last_depth`, and evaluate the best special path ending at this node.
On node exit restore previous `last_depth` and `start_depth`.
Update global answer with longest length and minimum node count among longest paths.
Run actual sample tests and key edge cases, and report the SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
